name: Unload and reload of chunks with pending ticks, block events and entities
note: A dropped chunk's pending ticks keep their remaining delay, counted from the tick after it dropped; after a reload its scheduled ticks and block entities run again two ticks later and its block events at once (both official servers)
deviations: the official servers may keep a dropped chunk at border for one or two ticks and restore a cached chunk during the command or in the chunk stage, which moves restored ticks by a tick between runs; Circuit drops chunks at once and restores them in the chunk stage
entities of unloaded chunks are not reported as unloaded
